narrative.overview: FamilyHubs rejects the sterile, clinical aesthetic of emergency hospitals and the cold, transactional blue-and-gray grid of gig-worker apps. Instead, the interface draws inspiration from heirloom trust, warmth, and Indian family devotion (Seva).
keyCharacteristics: Sculpted Heritage Typography: Eczar + Albert Sans

rules.name: The Warm Harmony Rule
rules.body: Gray is never cold or blue-tinted. Every neutral surface, divider, and secondary text tone carries warm yellow/red undertones from the linen and terracotta world.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section headings speak for themselves. Never place a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow or kicker above an Eczar headline.

dos: Do honor Indian cultural reverence for elders in copy, imagery, and respectful design details.
Do use Eczar for all major headings and modal titles with balanced sentence case.
Do ensure all text maintains strict WCAG AA/AAA compliance against warm linen grounds.
donts: Don't use cold clinical hospital blues, generic slate #F8FAFC, or harsh pure grays.
Don't stack kicker/eyebrow pills on top of section headings.
Don't nest cards inside cards or construct 4-column metric boxes with identical numbers.
